quote_a: The assembly point is by the north fence in the yard.
quote_b: The assembly point is at the marked area by the north fence, outside the fenced yard and clear of dock traffic and emergency access.
explanation: One section places the assembly point inside the yard while the other places it outside the fenced yard, which cannot both be true.

quote_a: They unload at inbound Doors 1-4, check documents before unloading is completed
quote_b: Documents are checked first, before anything is unloaded, under PR-01 Inbound receiving.
explanation: One section requires document check before any unloading starts while the other allows unloading to start before the check is completed.

quote_a: If capacity is unavailable, booked pallets wait secured in Zone A and are carried in the handover.
quote_b: Pallets awaiting put-away to the cage remain on the inbound trailer or on a marked holding position under supervision until cage space is confirmed.
explanation: One section says hazmat awaiting cage space waits in Zone A while the other says it remains on the trailer or holding position.

quote_a: Counting is done by staff assigned by the shift supervisor, checked by the stock controllers.
quote_b: All cycle counts are performed by stock controllers, supported by trained floor staff under the shift supervisor in charge.
explanation: One section makes floor staff responsible for counting with controllers checking, while the other makes controllers responsible with staff supporting.

quote_a: Racking safety is inspected separately from counting under PR-08.
quote_b: The Maintenance Technician carries out the documented racking safety inspection every month under PR-10
explanation: The same monthly racking safety inspection is assigned to PR-08 in one section and to PR-10 in the other.

quote_a: Identified at document check in Zone A, they are transferred promptly to Zone F without booking as stock
quote_b: They are never taken to Zones A, B, C, D or E before inspection.
explanation: One section says returns are in Zone A for document check while the other says returns are never taken to Zone A before inspection.
